questions.text: Do you have a job, or are you studying?

cueCard.topic: Describe a time when you felt bored.
cueCard.explain: and explain what you did to make the time pass.

questions.text: Describe a time when you felt bored.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a time when you felt bored. You should say: when it was; where you were; why you felt bored; and explain what you did to make the time pass.
Thank you. Do you often feel bored?

questions.text: What kinds of jobs do people find boring?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a time when you felt bored, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all boredom. What kinds of jobs do people find boring?

questions.text: Can being bored ever be a good thing?

questions.text: Why do some children say they are bored even when they have a lot of toys?

questions.text: Do you think people today have shorter attention spans than in the past?
